language_task: Snug the pillow into the case.
outcome_evidence: The pillow starts separate from the case (frame 0, ceiling and head_left), is positioned over it (frames 111–190, ceiling), and is progressively tucked under the case edges (frames 350–570, head_left and head_right). By frames 794–823, ceiling and head_left show the pillow seated within the case perimeter, with its white center visible through the opening and both grippers withdrawn. Completion follows a sustained interval without visible progress.

failure_annotations.explanation: The robot remains essentially stationary around the partly fitted pillow for approximately four seconds, without visibly advancing the remaining adjustment; compare frames 611, 630 and 649 in ceiling, head_left and wrist_right. Task-directed gripper movement resumes at approximately frame 650; the reason for the pause is not visible.
failure_annotations.recovery: Resume a controlled adjustment of the remaining loose case edge while stabilizing the pillow, then release and inspect the fit; no human intervention is visibly needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The visible consequence is delay; the pillow and case remain on the work surface without observed damage.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The environment remains in a usable intermediate state, so adjustment can resume without an environmental reset or human intervention.
